title: FinancePy floating lookback calls: a finite price becomes unavailable
summary: A valid floating lookback call worth about 54.03 becomes unavailable because a power overflows before multiplication by a tiny probability. A local log-space candidate removes 52 failing public calls on a 600-row grid; restoration reproduces all 52.
limits: Synthetic CPU scalar calls; no real trade, bank integration or customer loss; no full-suite or complete-stability claim. GERO quote adapter, not an upstream order subsystem.
measured_chain: Intermediate power overflow -> actual public pricing exception/NaN -> synthetic GERO quote document UNAVAILABLE instead of READY.
